title: Luscious Spanish Glace Cherry Paella
description: A jammy, crunchy, pescatarian-friendly Spanish dish combining the sweetness of glace cherries with the flaky texture of lamination-puff.
instructions: Heat the Grapeseed Oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat. Add the Smoked Paprika and cook for 1 minute. Add the Garlic and saut  for 2 minutes. Add the Rice and stir to coat with the Oil and Spice mixture.
Add the Chicken Broth and bring to a boil. Stir in the Saffron Threads and cook for 5 minutes. Add the Fish Sauce and stir to combine.
Add the Lamination-puff to the pan and cook for 2 minutes. Use a spatula to gently press down on the Puff, creating a layer on the bottom of the pan.
Add the Glaces Cherries to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring to combine with the Rice and Puff.
Transfer the pan to a preheated oven at 375	9F for 15 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes. Serve hot, garnished with additional Glaces Cherries if desired.
